1.Title: Slide 1
1.Description: You awaken in a desert, alone and unarmed. You could

2.Title: Slide 2
2.Description: You reach a tower after a short walk. You walk closer to it

3.Title: Slide 3
3.Description: You look around, you spot something shiny in a low patch of sand, there is also a tall mount of sand.

choices.choice2: Walk onto the tall mount of sand.

4.Title: Slide 4
4.Description: In attempts of climbing the mound, you have lost your footing and fallen. You are now on a low flatground of sand. Quicksand.

5.Title: Slide 5
5.Description: You hunt for the shiny, it’s a key of sorts. You are unsure what it’s to though. You also find that, while trying to find out what this is, you feel as though the sand is pulling you in, the ground seemingly swimming upward.

choices.choice1: As fast as you can climb out
choices.choice3: Swim down deeper into the quicksand

6.Title: Slide 6
6.Description: Wait a second, you’re just a little dizzy, it wasn’t quicksand after all. You feel stupid, but hey, at least you have this key.

7.Title: Slide 7
7.Description: What are you searching for? A way out? A will to go forth? You won’t find any here. You slowly suffocate with the fear of never making back to civilization.

8.Title: Slide 8
8.Description: You walk quite the way, you soon look up and see a tower.

9.Title: Slide 9
9.Description: You walk into the tower, it’s rather spacious. There are levers, but it seems like there is no way up the tower, no staircase or hole in the ceiling even. There are a set of levers. Two are green, one is red, and one is yellow.

10.Title: Slide 10
10.Description: It’s as if you just lit a match in a room filled with bombs, you explode into nothingness.

11.Title: Slide 11
11.Description: You flick the yellow, it seems that it’s correct, a ladder falls from the ceiling, allowing you passage to the upper floors.

12.Title: Slide 12
12.Description: You make it up the ladder, you find it’s a rather large room, there are tiles on the floor. There’s a sign on the left.

choices.choice3: Try to jump over the tiles

13.Title: Slide 13
13.Description: The sign reads as follows “Blue-Launches you into the air. Yellow- Electrifies you. Red-spikes. Green-safe. Purple-makes you smell like grapes. White- if you smell like grapes then you get eaten. Tan-Makes you fall.”

14.Title: Slide 14
14.Description: You can walk on one of five tiles. A blue tile, a purple tile on the left, a green tile, a yellow tile, or a purple tile on the right.

15.Title: Slide 15
15.Description: You walk onto the right purple tile. You now smell of grapes.

16.Title: Slide 16
16.Description: You are now on the green tile. You don’t feel that you should move forward.

17.Title: Slide 17
17.Description: You fall down into the other room.

18.Title: Slide 18
18.Description: The moment you touch the blue tile, you are launched into the air. You land head first into a white tile and are eaten alive.

19.Title: Slide 19
19.Description: You walk onto the white tile. Last mistake. The tile eats you alive.

20.Title: Slide 20
20.Description: You walk onto the yellow tile, you feel a slight shock. No, take that back. You are writhing in pain, one hundred thousand volt run through your body and you die.

choices.choice1: Wonder if you’re well cooked enough to eat

21.Title: Slide 21
21.Description: You walk onto the left purple tile. It smells like grapes. It’s a rather nice smell.

22.Title: Slide 22
22.Description: The purple tile smells aggressively like grapes. So aggressively in fact that you lose your balance. I’m kidding.

23.Title: Slide 23
23.Description: You are launched 50 feet into the air as soon as you step onto the blue, or, you would’ve went 50 feet if there wasn’t a roof. You are flattened against the roof now. In case ya didn’t know, people can’t survive that type of force.

choices.choice1: You are one of those people, you are deader than dead.

24.Title: Slide 24
24.Description: It’s a nice green tile. You love it here.

25.Title: Slide 25
25.Description: You are launched violently into the air, the wind rushing against your face. It feels rather nice, at least before you slam into the roof and get absolutely flattened.

26.Title: Slide 26
26.Description: This yellow tile, you dread it even before you touch it, but now you dread it a lot more, as you are now very very dead. As a hundred thousand volts runs throughout your entire body, you can only regret that you didn’t read that sign.

27.Title: Slide 27
27.Description: You love green. Such a great color. You look forward and see no immediate green tiles. Your hopes and dreams crushed, you make your choice. Your, final, choice.

28.Title: Slide 28
28.Description: You step on the red. You aren’t even trying, are ya? You are impaled all over your body, there is not a single spot on you that isn’t punctured.

29.Title: Slide 29
29.Description: After stepping on the white tile, you remember the smell of grapes. The lovely smell that the purple tiles gave to you. You are now eaten alive by the tile. Man, how unfortunate.

30.Title: Slide 30
30.Description: You try to step on the tan. You fall through, but instead of landing on the bottom floor, you just keep falling. There is no end.

choices.choice1: You fall for the rest of eternity.

31.Title: Slide 31
31.Description: Didn’t ya read? You are eaten alive the by white tile. What can I say.

choices.choice1: Heh. This is just whatcha get.

32.Title: Slide 32
32.Description: You would have walked onto the tan, if it didn’t disappear below your feet. You fall down to the first floor.

33.Title: Slide 33
33.Description: You walk onto the green. It’s a nice peaceful tile. You look behind you, all the tiles behind you are now red. You can’t go back.

34.Title: Slide 34
34.Description: You hesitantly walk onto the white tile. The tile opens up like a mouth and chomps you into a pulp.

35.Title: Slide 35
35.Description: You hesitantly walk onto the red. It isn’t long before you are a very appetizing kebab.

36.Title: Slide 36
36.Description: You step on the blue, before you can tell, you fly into the air, landing on your back. The wind is taken out of you. You try to get up and you accidentally let your right hand onto a red tile. The entire floor engules you in spikes. You are very very dead.

37.Title: Slide 37
37.Description: You step onto the green tile, you can now step on one of three tiles

38.Title: Slide 38
38.Description: You step onto the purple, you now smell aggressively like grapes.

39.Title: Slide 39
39.Description: You step on the blue tile, it springs up and lifts you with a force unmatched. You are flattened against the ceiling. Ironic huh,  you wanted to go up and ya did.

40.Title: Slide 40
40.Description: Really? Instantly after stepping on a purple you want to step on a white? Well, by all means. You go to step on the tile, but it opens from beneath your feet and swallows you, get this, HOLE.

41.Title: Slide 41
41.Description: You step onto the green tile. Wow, you can walk!

42.Title: Slide 42
42.Description: You step onto the yellow tile. At first it feels kind of nice, then you realize that a hundred thousand volts are going through you, you convulse violently on the floor and eventually die.

43.Title: Slide 43
43.Description: You step onto another green tile Man, this walking is incredible.

44.Title: Slide 44
44.Description: You want to step on the red? That was by far the worst choice. As you commit to the red tile, spike protrude from the ground, this isn’t quite as good as acupuncture. Heh

45.Title: Slide 45
45.Description: You try to step on the white, but it opens up, like a mouth, and consumes you. You truly should’ve read the details.

46.Title: Slide 46
46.Description: You look down at the tan. You know this isn’t a good choice,  but it’s the best of the few. You jump fully onto the tile, falling through and landing on the first floor.

47.Title: Slide 47
47.Description: You attempt to step on the tan tile, but instead of finding purchase, you fall.

choices.choice1: Go back to the first floor.

48.Title: Slide 48
48.Description: You step onto the white tile.

49.Title: Slide 49
49.Description: You should’ve just read the instructions. You step onto the tan tile, but instead of finding a solid surface, you just fall through the floor.

choices.choice1: You are back on the first floor.

50.Title: Slide 50
50.Description: This blue tile looks a bit funny, but I suppose it doesn’t matter now, you march on to the blue tile. It seems to support you, that is until you finally commit to the step. You are launched upward at incredible speeds and you hit your head against the roof, breaking your neck and skull.

51.Title: Slide 51
51.Description: You are now on the green tile.

52.Title: Slide 52
52.Description: Why would you pick such a hostile color? Oh, whatever. You step onto the red tile and suddenly spike emerge from the floor, stabbing all of you.

53.Title: Slide 53
53.Description: You move to step on the yellow tile, but you feel that you shouldn’t as soon as you begin to commit. You are fried into a crisp by a hundred thousand volts.

choices.choice1: You had the choice right in front of you.

54.Title: Slide 54
54.Description: You are now on the green tile

55.Title: Slide 55
55.Description: You feel as though someone is laughing at you. That would be me, and I have to see this too. You walk carelessly onto the tan tile, feeling like that’d be a good choice. You very quickly find out that you’ve been fooled as you step onto an open pit where the tan used to be.

56.Title: Slide 56
56.Description: How many red tiles have you stepped on at this point man? Just go back to the start. You’re gonna make me describe this again? Fine, you step on the red tile and instantly get punctured by hundreds of spikes from all directions, killing you instantly.

57.Title: Slide 57
57.Description: You are now on the white tile

58.Title: Slide 58
58.Description: You step forth, laying your foot upon the red tile. Collision results in instant spikes, poking from the walls in every direction.

59.Title: Slide 59
59.Description: Before you even begin to move for the yellow tile, electricity consumes your body. Maybe it could sense that you wanted to go onto that tile.

60.Title: Slide 60
60.Description: You have successfully passed the tiles, congrats, you may now move up the floors and climb to the top.

61.Title: Slide 61
61.Description: The ladder is metal, a little rusty but in good condition. You climb to the top and see a small shop, but more importantly a water fountain, you’ve been dying for something to drink, you can hardly wait to drink some water.

62.Title: Slide 62
62.Description: The man is big and bulky, he doesn’t look like someone you’d want to fight. He sizes you up, then finally says. “A new face, don’t see many of those these days. What do you want.”

63.Title: Slide 63
63.Description: The man looks at you. Really, looks at you. “You want to know a thing about time travel? I have the feeling you’d know better than me, this isn’t your first time here, is it. That kind of makes me wonder.” You can’t hear the rest of what he says, you zone out for a second.

choices.choice1: Go on then, see for yourself.

65.Title: Slide 65
65.Description: Clearly unsurprised by the question, he pulls out a water bottle. “Ah, I’ve got you. Here, drink up, it’s BPA free.”.

66.Title: Slide 66
66.Description: The water is quite nice, it goes down easy and it tastes good.

67.Title: Slide 67
67.Description: You climb up the next ladder, you are now on the fourth floor. You feel quite happy with that. You look around, seeing cold stone walls almost fully surrounding you. You feel like you’re missing something.

68.Title: Slide 68
68.Description: You move forward. It’s a maze, you’re sure of it now. There is a four way here.

69.Title: Slide 69
69.Description: You turn to the left, it’s a short walk before the next intersection. You reach it safely.

70.Title: Slide 70
70.Description: You search around, you see a keyhole not far from you. If you have a key, you may use it.

choices.choice1: Use the key if you have one and skip this floor

71.Title: Slide 71
71.Description: You greadily gulp down the water just about as fast as you can, you feel it going down your throat, only after you’ve drank quite the large amount do you realize the taste. It’s bitter, maybe even a bit sour. But, to be fair, I wouldn’t expect fresh water in a desert either. Your insides twist and you feel nauseous.

72.Title: Slide 72
72.Description: You decide to take a short rest. You rest for a good amount of time. Oh wait, now that’s funny. When you wake up you find that you have a bit of a sleepwalking problem. You are in the middle of the tiles, and you stumble onto a red tile, hundreds of different spikes invade your body, I’d rather not describe it any further, this is hard to watch.

73.Title: Slide 73
73.Description: Fine. Your skin is barely coating your flesh, blood spews everywhere, your organs are all more concepts of organs now, the majority of your bones are broken and there is now vomit on the floor. Happy?

74.Title: Slide 74
74.Description: You find that you’d never make the olympics. You try to jump over the tiles and you fall over a red tile. Spike emerge and puncture your face.

75.Title: Slide 75
75.Description: You cl- wait what. Why would you want to play with the levers? What’s the point? Oh whatever. You flick the levers, after flicking the red your entire world is engulfed in flames, it was rigged to a bomb.

76.Title: Slide 76
76.Description: You flip one green, then the ground beneath you falls. You are freeeee. Free falling. Then, a sudden end occurs when you are impaled by spikes at the bottom of the pit. You see now why traps in towers are so effective.

77.Title: Slide 77
77.Description: You walk around the tower, kicking the base to disrespect it as you pass. After a couple steps you fall over, no wait, a big stone object hits you down. It’s the tower, the tower has fallen on top of you. That kick really did it in huh?

78.Title: Slide 78
78.Description: It is notably, not the key to your heart.

79.Title: Slide 79
79.Description: You decide to swim deeper into the sand. You quickly that there is no bottom. Ya die.

80.Title: Slide 80
80.Description: You climb out, it’s not graceful, but you are out. It is only when your out that you realize that you dropped the key. This has totaled to be waste of time, congrats.

choices.choice1: Try to get the key back

82.Title: Slide 82
82.Description: In attempts to find the key, you find that quite a lot of time has gone by, sunburns paint your body, the pain is awful. You now see and have the key. It’s rather hot now. In fact, it feel so hot that it almost feels deformed.

83.Title: Slide 83
83.Description: You sit there, your not even sure why anymore, but you sit nevertheless. Waiting. Waiting. Waiting still. It feels like it’s been days, the sun still boiling your blood. You now have a rather gnarly sunburn. Congrats.

84.Title: Slide 84
84.Description: You, continue… To deprave yourself, even though the sun is quite literally cooking you. Hours more pass, the sun has fallen down, it is night. The cold is a terrible contrast, it is quite unpleasant. But at least your not being cooked alive anymore.

85.Title: Slide 85
85.Description: Why are you still waiting? What’s the point? Oh whatever, you wait more and the sun goes back up, back down, back up, and back down again. Three days you have waited. You don’t want to wait anymore.

86.Title: Slide 86
86.Description: You try to stand up, but all you can do is sit, your legs have gone weak, your mind frail. You are doomed to die here, with no energy left you lie there and eventually the time comes and you die.

87.Title: Slide 87
87.Description: It’s all sand. It’s always been sand. You’ve lost your mind, you haven’t slept in three days, you haven’t walked in three days, you haven’t been in three days. You die with the pain of a thousand sunburns and dehydration, malnutrition, and lack of sleep. If I didn’t know any better, I’d be thinking your a coder.

88.Title: Slide 88
88.Description: You, finally, decide to start walking. It isn’t long before the sun, quite literally, cooks you alive. The pain you feel is unmatched. But, you can see, not far in the distance, an oasis, water. There’s water!

choices.choice2: March onward away from the water

89.Title: Slide 89
89.Description: Wow, just accepting your fate, letting pain win? Disappointing. Get out of here, coward.

90.Title: Slide 90
90.Description: You die to dehydration after a short walk.

91.Title: Slide 91
91.Description: The water! So fine. But wait, it’s so dry. It’s almost like it’s just sand. It is just sand. It was a mirage. You succumb to your agony, and die. Perhaps waiting for hours on end was a bad idea.
